gramlot-js-server 0.2.5 aligns the documentation of the three packages with the core 0.2.6 and `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.5. The packages have no code changes; their version follows the repository.

## Changes

- Documentation
  - The guide index names the three packages, `@gramlot/create` included.
  - The remote Source example points to `controllers/08_remote_source.js` of gramlot-examples (gallery key `c08`), no longer to a folder of the core.
  - `js_requires` and `css_requires` need a Host with a resource system; the resource system comes with genro-kajenn, part of Genro.
  - The `npm start` of the `npm create @gramlot` templates is for development: the page template serves the project folder, `node_modules` included. A deployment uses the output of `npm run build`.
  - The reference of the command `gramlot` explains how it coexists with the Python command `gramlot` of gramlot-py-server: this one through `npx` or `node_modules/.bin`, the Python one inside its virtual environment.
  - Retired core package names are worded as retired; the guides state minimum versions, not the current release, which the README holds.
  - The internal notes GN-005, GN-010, GS-010 and GS-030 carry a historical banner with a pointer to the current guides; GS-005, GS-015 and GS-020 describe the current exporter.
- Tests
  - The browser checks of the gallery wait for the logo image before reading its size.
  - The gallery tests run against `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.5.

```sh
npm create @gramlot page my-form
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-js-server
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-serverless
```

## Verified

Node.js 23.11 and Bun 1.3.14, with the core 0.2.6, `@genrojs/builders` 0.4.2 and `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.5: the tests of the three packages; in Chromium 153 the server checks (mount prefix, page logic, CSP) on Node and Bun; in Chromium 153 and WebKit 26.6 the exported files (hello world, Source live, inline code), the quick start and the page module as file and directory, the gallery on Node and Bun under `/js`, the gallery from disk, the templates from disk and from `npm start`.
